// Historical R3.1 authoring source; not a generator for the current R3.2 seal.
import {readFileSync,writeFileSync,mkdirSync} from 'node:fs';
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
const sha=b=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');
const dest='tests/fixtures/profile-lot0/';
const design=readFileSync(process.argv[2],'utf8').split('\n');
const write=(p,data)=>writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(data,null,2)+'\n');
// Transcribe normative tables, without evaluating any profile data.
const rules=design.slice(161,175).map((line,i)=>{const cells=line.split('|');return {id:`CR-${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}`,name:cells[1].trim().slice(6),check:cells[2].trim(),codes:[...cells[3].matchAll(/`([^`]+)`/g)].map(m=>m[1]),provenance:`DESIGN.R31.md:${162+i}`};});
const actions=[
['bind',['create','edit','complete','normalize','reference','export','convert','migrate'],[]],
['refuse',['create','edit','complete','normalize','reference','export','convert','migrate'],[]],
['create',['create','edit','reference','complete','convert','migrate'],['parent:/property:create']],
['ensure',['normalize'],['parent:/property:create','envelope:/bindings:binding']],
['set',['create','edit','reference','complete','normalize','convert','migrate'],['target:scalar:set']],
['unset',['create','edit','reference','complete','normalize','convert','migrate'],['target:scalar:unset']],
['assignRef',['create','edit','reference','complete','normalize','convert','migrate'],['target:reference:reference']],
['reparent',['edit','convert','migrate','normalize'],['target::reparent','parent:/property:reparent']],
['place',['normalize'],['target::placement']],['emit',['export'],['self::artifact']],['loss',['export'],['target::report']],['remove',['edit','convert','migrate'],['target::remove']]
].map(([action,phases,writes])=>({action,phases,writes,...(action==='reparent'?{normalizeCondition:'specifically approved structural support move only'}:{}),provenance:'DESIGN.R31.md:177'}));
write('docs/design/profile-compiler-rules.json',{format:'profile-compiler-rule-table/1',revision:'R3.1',designSha256:sha(Buffer.from(design.join('\n'))),rules,actions,actorMapping:{create:'editor',edit:'editor',reference:'editor',convert:'editor',migrate:'editor',complete:'code',normalize:'code',export:[]},authorityComposition:['pinned base field producers','explicitly admitted extension-field producers','producerDelta replaces named from actor with to; absent from refuses profile-producer'],precedence:['lexical','schema','static','compatibility','integrity','evaluation'],precedenceScope:'Phase dependency only. R3.1 does not define a total tie-break between simultaneous static failures; this table does not invent one. Specialized CR-13/14 codes remain the normative mappings even when schema conditionals detect them.',lexicalCodes:['profile-json','profile-json-duplicate-key','profile-unicode','profile-number'],lexicalDependency:'Forthcoming R3.2 section 2.1; exact codes instructed for this seal',approval:{defaults:'ratified',bothLaneExpectationAgreement:'pending',staticTieBreak:'unresolved'},provenance:['DESIGN.R31.md:44','DESIGN.R31.md:46','DESIGN.R31.md:158','DESIGN.R31.md:162','DESIGN.R31.md:174','DESIGN.R31.md:175','DESIGN.R31.md:192']});
const vectors=[];
function add(id,refs,derivation,expectedArtifacts,status='ok') {vectors.push({caseId:id,canonicalPath:`profile-parity-corpus/1/cases/${id}.json`,expectedStatus:status,expectedArtifacts,method:'hand-derived',author:'current authoring session',review:{status:'pending-independent-review',reviewer:null},provenance:refs.map(line=>`DESIGN.R31.md:${line}`),derivation});}
const artifact=(role,json)=>({role,json});
const verdict=(id,refs,why,code)=>add(id,refs,why,[artifact('verdict',code?{code,status:'refused'}:{status:'ok'})],code?`refused:${code}`:'ok');
// The strings below are literal expected bytes, not a call to a canonicalizer.
add('jcs-escapes',[236],'JCS escapes LF and the control scalar, leaves the accented scalar in UTF-8 and emits the surrounding JSON string quotes.',[{role:'canonical',text:'"A\\nBé\\u001f"'}]);
add('jcs-key-order',[236,238],'Compare UTF-16 code units: ASCII a precedes b, and the high surrogate D800 of U+10000 precedes E000.',[{role:'canonical',text:'{"a":2,"b":1}'},{role:'canonical',text:'{"𐀀":2,"":1}'}]);
add('jcs-numbers',[236,938],'Generic JCS uses ECMAScript shortest binary64 strings, the positive exponent sign, and zero for negative zero. This vector does not admit unsafe integral tokens into a profile.',[{role:'canonical',text:'[1e+21,1e-7,0,5e-324,1,100000000000000000000,123456789012345680000,0.000001]'}]);
// Hash utility only: JCS strings are authored explicitly for these four tuples.
const allocationStrings=['["profile-mechanism/1","Process_1","aid","new-note"]','["profile-mechanism/1","Definitions_support","collaboration","Process_A"]','["profile-mechanism/1","Process_é","aid","clé"]','["profile-mechanism/1","𐀀owner","slot-1","key-𐀀"]'];
add('identity-stable-id',[252,260],'Hash each explicitly authored UTF-8 allocation tuple with SHA-256, use all 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits, and prefix g_. Definition ownership for Collaboration is explicit.',[artifact('ids',allocationStrings.map(s=>'g_'+sha(Buffer.from(s))))]);
verdict('lexical-duplicate-keys',[46],'The raw key a and the escaped key \\u0061 decode to the same key. Refuse at the lexical boundary before schema validation. Exact code depends on the authorized R3.2 erratum.','profile-json-duplicate-key');
verdict('lexical-lone-surrogate',[46],'The decoded D800 code unit has no following low surrogate. It is not a Unicode scalar and must refuse before JSON/schema evaluation. Code is the instructed R3.2 mapping.','profile-unicode');
verdict('lexical-negative-zero',[46,236],'The token -0 is finite and safely integral; profile lexical parsing admits it and generic canonical identity renders it as 0.');
verdict('lexical-nonfinite',[46],'The numeric token 1e400 exceeds finite binary64 range. Refuse lexically rather than allowing Infinity into parsed data. Exact code is the instructed R3.2 mapping.','profile-number');
verdict('lexical-unsafe-integer',[46],'The mathematical integer 9007199254740993 exceeds 9007199254740991. Inspect its token before binary64 rounding and refuse with the instructed R3.2 numeric code.','profile-number');
add('schema-integer-one-zero',[61],'The schema integer domain is mathematical: 1.0 is finite, safe and integral. Both validators admit it and its canonical value is 1.',[artifact('verdict',{ajv:{ok:true},canonical:1,pythonJsonschemaFullmatch:{ok:true}})]);
add('schema-integer-fraction',[61],'The value 1.5 is not mathematically integral. Both validators reject its integer type; the profile boundary uses profile-schema.',[artifact('verdict',{ajv:{errors:[{keyword:'type'}],ok:false},pythonJsonschemaFullmatch:{ok:false}})],'refused:profile-schema');
add('schema-id-newline',[48,61],'Full-string pattern matching rejects trailing LF in id. Stock search-based matching is retained only as the documented reference divergence, never as profile acceptance.',[artifact('verdict',{ajv:{errors:[{keyword:'pattern'}],ok:false},pythonJsonschemaFullmatch:{ok:false},pythonJsonschemaStock:{documentedDivergence:'accepts',ok:true}})],'refused:profile-schema');
add('schema-keyword-subset',[48],'The closed 29-keyword subset omits format. The profile rejection is profile-schema-keyword; reference-specific ignore/throw outcomes remain documented, not substituted for it.',[artifact('verdict',{ajvStrict:{documentedDivergence:'throws unknown-format, differently from profile-schema-keyword',loadError:'unknown format'},closedSubset:{keyword:'format',known:false},pythonJsonschemaStock:{documentedDivergence:'ignores format without a FormatChecker',ok:true}})],'refused:profile-schema-keyword');
add('schema-external-ref-pinned',[48,65],'The compiled-options schema and its profile registry target are explicitly pinned inputs. Resolve the known reference from those bytes only; this reference fragment is valid.',[artifact('verdict',{ajv:{compiled:true,dataOk:true}})]);
add('schema-external-ref-unknown',[48,65],'The compiled-options reference has no supplied registry target in this case. Refuse profile-schema-ref; do not fetch it. The reference diagnostic is bounded comparator evidence.',[artifact('verdict',{ajv:{loadError:"can't resolve reference urn:profile-mechanism:1:profile#/$defs/rule"}})],'refused:profile-schema-ref');
add('lint-info-through-warn',[454,456],'Numeric severity 3 means info. The common adapter deliberately transports info as warn and restores effective info for both accept and draft policies.',[artifact('transport',{accept:{effective:'info',rule:'ad-hoc-sub-process',transport:'warn'},draft:{effective:'info',rule:'ad-hoc-sub-process',transport:'warn'}})]);
add('lint-warning-through-error',[456,458],'The generic rule transports at error while each profile subrule keeps its effective severity. Draft readiness warning counts as warn and does not fail acceptance.',[artifact('unified',{counts:{error:0,info:0,warn:1},ok:true,ruleId:'profile:ready-check',transport:'error',unifiedSeverity:'warn'})]);
for(const id of ['lint-unknown-lookup-none','lint-unknown-lookup-thrown'])add(id,[429],'Missing factories and the specific unknown-lookup exception both map to a typed lint-config-unknown integrity refusal. They never silently disable a rule.',[artifact('unified',{code:'lint-config-unknown',disposition:'refused',severity:'error'})],'refused:lint-config-unknown');

Preserve the two cycle members and refuse lint-config-cycle.',[artifact('unified',{code:'lint-config-cycle',cycle:['plugin:cycle/a','plugin:cycle/b'],disposition:'refused',severity:'error'})],'refused:lint-config-cycle');

add('lint-pointer-escaping',[479,724],'Index Task_1 at its immutable native pointer, then escape tilde before slash for each supplied segment. The unresolved ghost retains unavailable provenance and null pointer.',[artifact('coordinates',{pointer:'/rootElements/0/flowElements/0/a~0b/c~1d/0',provenance:'exact',targetId:'Task_1'}),artifact('coordinates',{pointer:null,provenance:'unavailable',targetId:'ghost'})]);
add('lint-alternating-profiles',[433,460],'Each evaluation uses its own compiled options and fresh linter state. The A to B to A sequence must restore the original A options without retaining B state.',[artifact('sequence',{evaluations:[{options:{'no-disconnected':'error'},profile:'profile-a'},{options:{'no-disconnected':'warn'},profile:'profile-b'},{options:{'no-disconnected':'error'},profile:'profile-a'}],freshLinterPerEvaluation:true})]);
write(dest+'expectations.json',{format:'profile-independent-expectations/1',designSha256:'020270f65e0be7b119365bb402ff062cf406fca92940709dd987d9dfdc8173f8',scope:'Independent hand derivations of the 23 canonical mechanism vectors.
